_readme: Ground truth for the eval set. 20 real objects, not printouts of clean
paragraphs: medicine bottles, glossy laminated menus, curved packaging,
low-contrast utility bills, handwriting, a bus timetable.
Photos go in tools/eval/images/ with the filename below. The mock server
saves every photo the device uploads to tools/captures/, so the easiest
way to build this set is to shoot it with the actual device.
'numbers' is the field that matters. Doses, expiry dates, bus numbers and
dollar amounts are the failure case people actually care about, and they
are scored as exact match. 'must_contain' is scored case-insensitively on
substrings. 'useful_spoken' is the human judgement, filled in by hand.
